entries.text: Eight built-in presets get you to a polished starting point in one click. Below the preset cards, the theme panel has a section for every detail: page, body text, headings, colours, tables, code, table of contents, diagrams, header and footer. Every change shows up in the preview right away. Here: a serif body font for long reading.

entries.caption: Tap the Theme tab on the bottom bar
The theme panel opens: preset cards at the top, a section per detail below.
Font, size, line height, colour, alignment, and the drop-cap switch.

entries.text: Switch the body text to a serif
The font list is grouped into sans-serif and serif families, each shown in its own typeface. Headings keep their own font, so only the running text changes.

entries.caption: Every font markoto offers, previewed in its own typeface.
The body font is now Source Serif 4, in the preview and in the PDF.

entries.text: The Colors section holds the brand and secondary colours: they paint links, highlights, header bands and other accents. Click a swatch to open a colour picker, or paste any hex value.

entries.caption: Brand and secondary colour, each behind a swatch.

next.why: Save the tuned theme as a preset to reuse it on your next document
